0033690ce81c.en: Feeling his gaze like facing a strong headwind, Eiri did a small gulp, "Current cost?"
0033690ce81c.t: Merasa renungannya seperti menghadap angin kencang dari depan, Eiri menelan liur sedikit, "Kos semasa?"

079b02fdd1a7.en: With a gulp, Sora nodded several times quickly, then kept switching her focus between the Queen and the King-maid. A slightly broken murmur came out of her first, turning into words, "I did, my Queen! I—I got the letter early today and did that! Her roommates did not see her at all after the 67th! Nobody knows she actually left!" Sora rapped through the words so quickly it was like playing at 2x speed.
079b02fdd1a7.t: Dengan telanan, Sora mengangguk beberapa kali dengan cepat, kemudian terus mengalihkan tumpuannya antara Permaisuri dan King-maid. Gumaman yang sedikit terputus-putus keluar daripadanya dahulu, bertukar menjadi kata-kata, "Ya, Permaisuriku! S—saya dapat surat awal hari ni dan buat tu! Rakan-rakan serumahnya langsung tak nampak dia selepas 67 haribulan! Tak ada sesiapa tahu dia betul-betul pergi!" Sora merap melalui kata-kata itu begitu cepat seperti dimainkan pada kelajuan 2x.

0927b1a4964f.en: "Hmmmm—why is that my fault?" Eiri furrowed her brow towards Neferteri. Feeling the last remains of the peacefulness of her safe space evaporating, her hand flew towards the half-eaten jar cake and shoved a spoonful into her mouth. The dark, stingy taste of the chocolate with coffee cream between the cake layers was still far sweeter than Neferteri had ever said or done to Eiri.
0927b1a4964f.t: "Hmmmm—kenapa tu salah aku?" Eiri mengerutkan keningnya ke arah Neferteri. Merasa sisa terakhir ketenangan tempat selamatnya menguap, tangannya terbang ke arah kek balang yang separuh dimakan dan menyumbat sesudu ke dalam mulutnya. Rasa coklat yang gelap dan pedih dengan krim kopi di antara lapisan kek masih jauh lebih manis daripada apa yang pernah Neferteri katakan atau lakukan kepada Eiri.

0e16112e15d7.en: "I—I DON'T KNOW WHAT TO SAY!" Eiri felt her chest and throat tighten. "That wasn't me! Yes! I wanted to contact Harry, I even requested my friends at Half-cruro to let me know where he was, but I didn't ask them to make contact! I know you would bitch about it if I did!" Eiri stood up, tears running down her cheeks as she pointed her yellow gloves towards Neferteri, "YOU KNOW WHAT? I'm getting sick of you blaming me for everything! I should have contacted him after all! You pushed him to sign something he couldn't grasp! I'm the King-maid! I'm supposed to stand on the same level as you, but all I've been doing this past year is getting stepped on!" She pointed towards a painting on the wall of her mother, Coema, "No wonder she was sick of you shit too!" A moment of realization came through as if something had finally clicked deep inside Eiri. "So what now? Just fire me already! Then what? Who are you replacing me with?"
0e16112e15d7.t: "A—AKU TAK TAHU NAK CAKAP APA!" Eiri merasa dada dan tekaknya sesak. "Tu bukan aku! Ya! Aku nak hubungi Harry, aku siap minta kawan-kawan aku kat Half-cruro bagi tahu aku kat mana dia, tapi aku tak minta mereka hubungi dia! Aku tahu awak akan merengek kalau aku buat!" Eiri berdiri, air mata mengalir di pipinya sambil dia menghalakan sarung tangan kuningnya ke arah Neferteri, "AWAK TAHU TAK? Aku dah muak dengan awak salahkan aku untuk semua benda! Patutnya aku hubungi dia je! Awak desak dia tandatangan sesuatu yang dia tak faham! Aku King-maid! Aku sepatutnya berdiri sama taraf dengan awak, tapi apa yang aku dapat sepanjang tahun lepas cuma kena pijak!" Dia menunjuk ke arah sebuah lukisan di dinding ibunya, Coema, "Patutlah dia pun muak dengan perangai sial awak!" Satu saat kesedaran datang seolah-olah sesuatu akhirnya tersedar jauh dalam diri Eiri. "Jadi sekarang apa? Pecat je la aku! Lepas tu apa? Siapa yang awak nak ganti aku?"

0f24fa8e72ba.en: *Now Neferteri has something to complain about—*Eiri kept patting Sora, "Thanks, Sora. I know we spent all night figuring out all these possible things to say to convince him to do the searches, but it was for nothing!" A strained laugh came from Eiri, "Hmmm—he just did it!"
0f24fa8e72ba.t: *Sekarang Neferteri ada benda nak dirungutkan—*Eiri terus menepuk Sora, "Terima kasih, Sora. Aku tahu kita habiskan sepanjang malam fikirkan semua benda yang mungkin nak cakap untuk yakinkan dia buat pencarian, tapi semua tu sia-sia!" Ketawa tegang datang dari Eiri, "Hmmm—dia terus buat je!"

13f63971a994.en: Vol 3 Chapter III subchapter 5: the blonde girl, the dark-haired woman and the red-haired maid read papers at the shop counter.
13f63971a994.t: Jilid 3 Bab III subbab 5: gadis berambut perang, wanita berambut gelap dan pembantu rumah berambut merah membaca kertas-kertas di kaunter kedai.

14ce89f65164.en: There's no way I can do level four! That's like an entire district worth of tax revenue for the year! A cold ran down her spine as the reality of the expenditure became more real. Her quick mental calculations tried to juggle how much money to put on it versus how much trouble she was in, coming up with a firm answer, "Level three for both, with reward set at one aquamarine per each? Four aquamarines in total?"
14ce89f65164.t: Tak mungkin aku boleh buat tahap empat! Tu macam hasil cukai satu daerah penuh untuk setahun! Sejuk mengalir di tulang belakangnya sementara realiti perbelanjaan itu menjadi lebih nyata. Pengiraan mental pantasnya cuba mengimbangkan berapa banyak wang untuk dibelanjakan berbanding berapa banyak masalah yang dihadapinya, menghasilkan jawapan yang tegas, "Tahap tiga untuk kedua-duanya, dengan ganjaran ditetapkan satu aquamarine setiap satu? Empat aquamarine kesemuanya?"

17639ec7080d.en: "Arukia's kingdom alert will be published after we've established contact with Emelia." Lofinghy stated, then continued, "Arukia never replied to her parents either. We will make contact with them."
17639ec7080d.t: "Amaran kerajaan Arukia akan disiarkan selepas kami membuat hubungan dengan Emelia." Lofinghy menyatakan, kemudian meneruskan, "Arukia tak pernah balas ibu bapanya juga. Kami akan hubungi mereka."

187973f440a6.en: "Your precious Harry is defaulting on his obligations." Neferteri, the queen of Sanbi, spoke monotonously, but one could still sense the venom in her dull, firm tone.
187973f440a6.t: "Harry kesayangan anda gagal memenuhi kewajipannya." Neferteri, permaisuri Sanbi, bercakap secara mendatar, tetapi orang masih dapat merasa bisa dalam nadanya yang hambar dan tegas.

188e2ddabece.en: "Yep!" Eiri took a deep, forced breath as she kept a tensed-up posture. "Our—our maid Arukia went missing on the way to visit her parents in Long Bridge." She pointed to both letters in front of the captain, "And Sanbi-eye—sanbi-eye Harry went missing too." She fought herself from showing any odd signs, but her shaking feet began disobeying her.
188e2ddabece.t: "Yep!" Eiri menarik nafas dalam yang dipaksa sambil dia mengekalkan postur yang tegang. "Pem—pembantu rumah kami Arukia hilang dalam perjalanan melawat ibu bapanya di Long Bridge." Dia menunjuk ke arah kedua-dua surat di hadapan kapten, "Dan Sanbi-eye—sanbi-eye Harry pun hilang." Dia melawan dirinya daripada menunjukkan sebarang tanda pelik, tetapi kakinya yang menggeletar mula ingkar.

19930671b852.en: You know what? Like lightning in thunder, something about that moment struck Eiri. A clear memory of Coema, on many occasions, saying the exact two words over and over, came to her mind. Every time she heard it growing up, she understood what it meant, but for the first time, she truly understood what Coema meant with it. She let go of the hug and patted Sora on the head. "Fuck it!"
19930671b852.t: Kau tahu tak? Seperti kilat dalam guruh, sesuatu tentang saat itu menyambar Eiri. Ingatan yang jelas tentang Coema, pada banyak kali, mengatakan dua perkataan yang sama berulang-ulang, muncul di fikirannya. Setiap kali dia mendengarnya semasa membesar, dia faham maksudnya, tetapi buat kali pertama, dia benar-benar faham apa yang Coema maksudkan dengannya. Dia melepaskan pelukan dan menepuk kepala Sora. "Peduli apa!"

1a04b27f3295.en: Vol 3 Chapter III subchapter 4: the blonde girl looks surprised as the dark-haired woman in gold crosses her arms.
1a04b27f3295.t: Jilid 3 Bab III subbab 4: gadis berambut perang kelihatan terkejut sementara wanita berambut gelap berpakaian emas berpeluk tubuh.

1a12bbe60fce.en: Sora fainted like clapping near a wooden-legged goat. Her limp body fell forward, and her head hit the table with a loud thud.
1a12bbe60fce.t: Sora pengsan seperti bertepuk berhampiran kambing yang kakinya kaku. Badannya yang lembik jatuh ke hadapan, dan kepalanya terhantuk meja dengan bunyi gedebuk yang kuat.

1c6da603b455.en: A name completely foreign invaded Eiri's ears. "No? Who's that?"
1c6da603b455.t: Satu nama yang sama sekali asing menceroboh telinga Eiri. "Tak? Siapa tu?"

1d1b5da0b421.en: Some time has passed since Neferteri had left the room, letting the peaceful sanctity of the economical room slowly begin to regenerate—or it was Sora's cuteness masking it all. Either way, it was working, as Eiri could feel a bit of respite as her mind tried to go over the details of what had just happened. Her eyes re-read the words of the same letter again, maybe expecting to read something else after the third time, but alas, it was still the same wobbly writing saying the same thing. "Why would someone abduct them for? It can't be for ransom since we got nothing in the mail! And, like, they aren't even Sanbi Royals! That doesn't make sense!"
1d1b5da0b421.t: Beberapa ketika telah berlalu sejak Neferteri meninggalkan bilik, membiarkan kesucian yang aman di bilik ekonomi perlahan-lahan mula pulih—atau kecomelan Sora yang menutupi semuanya. Walau apa pun, ia berkesan, kerana Eiri dapat merasa sedikit kelegaan sementara fikirannya cuba meneliti butiran apa yang baru berlaku. Matanya membaca semula kata-kata surat yang sama lagi, mungkin menjangkakan membaca sesuatu yang lain selepas kali ketiga, tetapi sayangnya, ia masih tulisan bergoyang yang sama mengatakan perkara yang sama. "Kenapa ada orang nak culik mereka? Takkan untuk wang tebusan sebab kita tak dapat apa-apa dalam mel! Dan, macam, mereka bukan pun Keluarga Diraja Sanbi! Tak masuk akal!"

1f9143665682.en: A restless night gave way to a bright new day. Eiri now faced eye-to-eye with a man she did not know much about in a place she rarely visited. The black decor gave an intense, unwelcoming vibe—for some people, but Eiri knew better to understand it was just the eccentric Forway culture doing their own thing. She sat up straight and looked at this armor-plated bald guy with baggy eyes and sallow cheeks. Her dulled expression was the opposite of where her mind stood. A fortified fortress of answers to any kind of what-if question she could think of. A grand action was about to commence, her heart ticking in her chest with the silence brewing.
1f9143665682.t: Malam yang gelisah memberi laluan kepada hari baru yang cerah. Eiri kini bertentang mata dengan seorang lelaki yang tidak banyak diketahuinya di tempat yang jarang dikunjunginya. Hiasan hitam memberikan aura yang kuat dan tidak mesra—bagi sesetengah orang, tetapi Eiri tahu lebih baik untuk memahami ia hanya budaya Forway yang eksentrik melakukan perkara mereka sendiri. Dia duduk tegak dan memandang lelaki botak berperisai ini dengan mata berkantung dan pipi cengkung. Riak wajahnya yang hambar bertentangan dengan di mana fikirannya berada. Kubu pertahanan jawapan yang diperkukuh kepada sebarang soalan "bagaimana jika" yang dapat difikirkannya. Tindakan besar akan bermula, jantungnya berdetak di dada dengan kesunyian yang membuak.

21f2f832ce1b.en: A quiet sobbing came out of Sora, still pale white, but more conscious than before! Although her upper body was glued to the table.
21f2f832ce1b.t: Esakan perlahan keluar dari Sora, masih putih pucat, tetapi lebih sedar daripada sebelumnya! Walaupun badan atasnya melekat pada meja.

23414b99dfdb.en: Lofinghy opened the tome right on the first large black feather bookmark, opening the book about three-fourths of the way. Quickly glancing through the logs, he demanded an answer: "Emelia Lakeeye Rich-Flower. Do you know of her?"
23414b99dfdb.t: Lofinghy membuka buku tebal itu tepat pada penanda buku bulu hitam besar yang pertama, membuka buku itu kira-kira tiga perempat jalan. Cepat-cepat mengerling log-log itu, dia menuntut jawapan: "Emelia Lakeeye Rich-Flower. Kenal dia?"

23878c570cca.en: "Half-backed requests beget half-backed searches." Lofinghy further stated, now placing his hand on the other letter neatly placed in front of him. "Sanbi-eye. What is the expected arrangement between adventurers and Sanbi guards?"
23878c570cca.t: "Permintaan separuh masak melahirkan pencarian separuh masak." Lofinghy seterusnya menyatakan, kini meletakkan tangannya pada surat lain yang diletakkan kemas di hadapannya. "Sanbi-eye. Apakah susunan yang dijangka antara pengembara dan pengawal Sanbi?"

23d15233a9cd.en: Eiri squeezed Sora tightly, imprisoning her between her arms. "Absolutely not!" She whispered loudly.
23d15233a9cd.t: Eiri memeluk erat Sora, memenjarakannya di antara lengannya. "Sama sekali tidak!" Dia berbisik dengan kuat.

26f136202e7e.en: "Wait! Like abducting them? But! but—" Eiri stopped herself, Why would someone do that for? What would mom do? Get Half-cruro involved?
26f136202e7e.t: "Kejap! Macam culik mereka? Tapi! tapi—" Eiri menghentikan dirinya, Kenapa ada orang nak buat macam tu? Apa yang mak akan buat? Libatkan Half-cruro?

2821b37a5fa5.en: Sora kept looking at the calendar with detailed plans for all the maids' scheduling. The neatly tied colored buttons representing each maid popped the grid columns and rows with a shower of colors. It was a complex imagery, but after a few seconds, that sea of colors was as straightforward as a Jackson Pollock piece once you accept he was just flinging paint like a caffeinated madman.
2821b37a5fa5.t: Sora terus memandang kalendar dengan rancangan terperinci untuk semua jadual pembantu rumah. Butang-butang berwarna yang diikat kemas mewakili setiap pembantu rumah menyerlahkan lajur dan baris grid dengan hujan warna. Ia imej yang rumit, tetapi selepas beberapa saat, lautan warna itu sama mudahnya seperti karya Jackson Pollock sebaik sahaja anda menerima dia cuma melontar cat seperti orang gila yang terlebih kafein.

285d16c57585.en: "M—maybe—" an inaudible ramble came out of Sora.
285d16c57585.t: "M—mungkin—" racauan yang tidak kedengaran keluar dari Sora.

33bceddb0262.en: "Deal." Lofinghy pounded the door again. Exactly the same way as before, even the space between the two pounds was the same.
33bceddb0262.t: "Setuju." Lofinghy mengetuk pintu lagi. Sama tepat seperti tadi, malah jarak antara dua ketukan itu sama.

38812ebe6d5c.en: Relaxing her shoulders and letting out a loud sigh, Eiri placed her hand on Sora, still shaking atop the table with a white, pale face and trembling eyes, in a half-conscious, half-passed-out state. "We actually did it. Sanbi shit!"
38812ebe6d5c.t: Mengendurkan bahunya dan melepaskan keluhan kuat, Eiri meletakkan tangannya pada Sora, masih menggeletar di atas meja dengan muka putih pucat dan mata menggeletar, dalam keadaan separuh sedar, separuh pengsan. "Kita betul-betul berjaya. Demi jiwa tua Sanbi!"

3e7f4646276c.t: ← Bab IV - Cuti yang Tidak Diingini

3eebe25a00b0.en: Two knocks followed by a guard entering and handing over a thick tome of a black book, "Here, Cap!" The guard closed the door just as swiftly.
3eebe25a00b0.t: Dua ketukan diikuti seorang pengawal masuk dan menyerahkan sebuah buku hitam yang tebal, "Ini, Kap!" Pengawal itu menutup pintu sama pantas.

4070678c742e.en: A simple nod came out of Neferteri, closing her eyes to, one would guess, chew through the details of Eiri's ramble. A few short nods later, a simple statement came out of her, "That is the proof I was seeking from you."
4070678c742e.t: Anggukan ringkas datang dari Neferteri, memejamkan matanya untuk, orang akan meneka, mengunyah butiran racauan Eiri. Beberapa anggukan pendek kemudian, kenyataan ringkas keluar daripadanya, "Itulah bukti yang saya cari daripada anda."

46e0639eab4b.en: Neferteri stood there, silently standing up, stoically observing the outburst.
46e0639eab4b.t: Neferteri berdiri di situ, diam berdiri, dengan tabah memerhatikan letusan itu.

493a5609224c.en: "You have her blood. You know what to do! Make Neferteri ease up on log requests!" Captain Lofinghy walked out and closed the door with a good bang.
493a5609224c.t: "Darah dia mengalir dalam diri awak. Awak tahu apa nak buat! Buat Neferteri kurangkan permintaan log!" Kapten Lofinghy berjalan keluar dan menutup pintu dengan dentuman yang kuat.

4ab1b157736b.en: Lofhinghy silently read through the letters.
4ab1b157736b.t: Lofhinghy membaca surat-surat itu dalam diam.

4c7f863c46b8.en: "No exceptions. We have a kingdom to run, and we do not need another fiasco to our public image as it stands. Until I state otherwise, this conversation shall not leave this room, for we do not know the source and the reasoning behind this." Neferteri turned and walked towards the door, closing it softly on her way out.
4c7f863c46b8.t: "Tiada pengecualian. Kita ada kerajaan untuk ditadbir, dan kita tidak memerlukan satu lagi kegagalan kepada imej awam kita seperti sekarang. Sehingga saya menyatakan sebaliknya, perbualan ini tidak akan keluar dari bilik ini, kerana kita tidak tahu sumber dan sebab di sebaliknya." Neferteri berpaling dan berjalan ke arah pintu, menutupnya dengan perlahan dalam perjalanan keluar.

4cb7b2588d38.en: Meanwhile, a constrained laughter came from Eiri, "I don't think he was her type. Actually—" Something did not stir right within Eiri, "Now that I think about it—I don't even know what her type was. I guess she was playful and—"
4cb7b2588d38.t: Sementara itu, ketawa tertahan datang dari Eiri, "Saya tak rasa dia citarasa Arukia. Sebenarnya—" Sesuatu tidak terasa betul dalam diri Eiri, "Bila saya fikir balik—saya tak tahu pun apa citarasa dia. Rasanya dia suka bergurau dan—"

4d895311f081.en: "But of course!” Eiri put her hands up in the air, “You were the one who sparked a fire under my butt! And I'm a Sanbi Royal, after all! We can go straight to his ears!" Eiri sounded resolute in her reply.
4d895311f081.t: "Mestilah!” Eiri mengangkat tangannya ke udara, “Kau yang nyalakan api bawah punggung aku! Dan aku Diraja Sanbi, lagipun! Kita boleh terus sampai ke telinga dia!" Eiri kedengaran tegas dalam jawapannya.

51a23157651e.en: A bitter silence enveloped the room. I—I—what can I even say? Eiri hung her head, looking for answers. Tears broke through as her chest pained at the thought of leaving the maids on their own, and imagining a rotting Harry corpse in the middle of nowhere, all because of what she said to him that odd night, and helped him sign the contract.
51a23157651e.t: Kesunyian yang pahit menyelubungi bilik itu. A—aku—apa yang aku boleh cakap pun? Eiri menundukkan kepalanya, mencari jawapan. Air mata pecah sementara dadanya sakit memikirkan meninggalkan para pembantu rumah sendirian, dan membayangkan mayat Harry yang mereput di tengah-tengah entah mana, semuanya kerana apa yang dikatakannya kepadanya malam yang ganjil itu, dan membantunya menandatangani kontrak.

52bcdac81ed0.en: "What about Harry? What will happen to him?" Eiri took out a fancy-looking flannel from the desk drawer to wipe away her tears.
52bcdac81ed0.t: "Macam mana dengan Harry? Apa akan jadi kat dia?" Eiri mengeluarkan kain flanel yang kelihatan mewah dari laci meja untuk mengesat air matanya.

5483da60decf.en: "Ahhh—" Many words surged to come out, but not a single one wanted to be the first thing out of Eiri's mouth.
5483da60decf.t: "Ahhh—" Banyak perkataan meluru untuk keluar, tetapi tiada satu pun mahu menjadi yang pertama keluar dari mulut Eiri.

5637870e20a0.en: Like an exploding grenade, Sora fell on her knees and started sobbing loudly.
5637870e20a0.t: Seperti bom tangan meletup, Sora jatuh melutut dan mula teresak-esak dengan kuat.

584215e46520.en: The peaceful sanctity of Sanbi's economical department was once again perturbed!
584215e46520.t: Kesucian yang aman di jabatan ekonomi Sanbi sekali lagi diganggu!

5bf66919de29.en: This is the village elder writing on their behalf since they can't read. They haven't talked to their daughter for more than a year, ever since she told them she went to work as a maid for your Kingdom. She didn't even stay with us on her way to Sanbi. She never replied to our letters either. We only knew she was alive because a friend merchant did me a favor, but she blew him off. We think that she sees us as beneath her! We know it's not much, but it's honest work! Despite all that happened, please tell her that we all miss her very much, and she has a home to come to if she ever needs it
5bf66919de29.t: Ini ketua kampung yang menulis bagi pihak mereka kerana mereka tak tahu membaca. Mereka tak bercakap dengan anak perempuan mereka lebih daripada setahun, sejak dia beritahu mereka dia pergi bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah untuk Kerajaan kamu. Dia tak singgah pun dengan kami dalam perjalanan ke Sanbi. Dia tak pernah balas surat-surat kami juga. Kami cuma tahu dia masih hidup sebab seorang kawan saudagar tolong saya, tapi dia buat tak endah. Kami rasa dia pandang rendah kami! Kami tahu ia tak seberapa, tapi ia kerja yang jujur! Walaupun semua yang berlaku, tolong beritahu dia yang kami semua sangat rindukan dia, dan dia ada rumah untuk pulang kalau dia perlukan

5d65d33df088.en: Sora put her small hands up in the air, making a slight shrug while also recoiling inwards.
5d65d33df088.t: Sora mengangkat tangan kecilnya ke udara, membuat angkat bahu yang sedikit sambil juga mengecut ke dalam.

5f8d1c44a767.en: Sora's tiny hands covered her mouth, funneling the words of her mouth towards Eiri.
5f8d1c44a767.t: Tangan kecil Sora menutup mulutnya, menyalurkan kata-kata dari mulutnya ke arah Eiri.

625a1a271ac6.en: Eiri's eyes shone wide as she chewed on another spoonful of jar cake. It wasn't the fantastic contrasting taste of the bitter, dark creamy against the sweet milky cake that surprised me; it was the string of words that just came out of Neferteri's mouth. She chewed and gulped as her brain tried to find any string of words combo to defend herself. "—I—I didn't do it!" That was the best thing her brain could snap back. "What do you want from me?" She blinked with an open stare towards this invasive species tainting what was supposed to be a calm Sunnohigh—late afternoon.
625a1a271ac6.t: Mata Eiri bersinar luas sambil dia mengunyah sesudu lagi kek balang. Bukan rasa kontras yang hebat antara krim gelap yang pahit dengan kek bersusu yang manis yang mengejutkan aku; ia rentetan kata-kata yang baru keluar dari mulut Neferteri. Dia mengunyah dan menelan sementara otaknya cuba mencari apa-apa gabungan rentetan kata-kata untuk mempertahankan dirinya. "—A—aku tak buat!" Itu perkara terbaik yang dapat dibalas otaknya. "Apa yang awak nak dari aku?" Dia berkelip dengan renungan terbuka ke arah spesies penceroboh ini yang mencemari apa yang sepatutnya Sunnohigh yang tenang—lewat petang.

63d54c09a979.en: Neferteri took her time, then stared back at Eiri, "If that is truly the case, then please indulge me in an in-depth explanation as to why the Sanbi-eye disappeared without a trace after leaving Green Sea towards Depoint. I requested an update from Chief Manbola, and she stated Harry had never arrived. Chief Tupinamba stated that Harry did indeed leave towards Depoint. Furthermore!" Her tone became sharper, just like her intense staring, "The Sanbi-eye left such a positive impression on Chief Tupinamba that he sent a search party composed of locals and two guards without requesting funding to do so. The mere mention that Harry did not arrive at Depoint was enough of a trigger for the other chief to partake in the search. Truly, the Sanbi-eye position is of utmost importance to keep these people in check.” Taking a deep breath and closing her eyes to regain her composure, Neferteri continued. “Regardless, despite all knowing they wouldn't be as thorough as a high-ranking adventurer, they found absolutely no traces. No attacks from wild animals. No attacks from bandits. No corpse. With that said, indulge me in proving you were not involved."
63d54c09a979.t: Neferteri mengambil masanya, kemudian merenung balik Eiri, "Jika itu benar-benar berlaku, maka sila berikan saya penjelasan yang mendalam mengapa Sanbi-eye hilang tanpa jejak selepas meninggalkan Green Sea menuju ke Depoint. Saya meminta kemas kini daripada Ketua Manbola, dan dia menyatakan Harry tidak pernah tiba. Ketua Tupinamba menyatakan bahawa Harry memang bertolak ke Depoint. Tambahan pula!" Nadanya menjadi lebih tajam, sama seperti renungannya yang tajam, "Sanbi-eye meninggalkan kesan yang begitu positif kepada Ketua Tupinamba sehingga dia menghantar pasukan pencari yang terdiri daripada penduduk tempatan dan dua pengawal tanpa meminta pembiayaan untuk berbuat demikian. Sekadar menyebut bahawa Harry tidak tiba di Depoint sudah cukup untuk mencetuskan ketua yang lain untuk turut serta dalam pencarian. Sesungguhnya, jawatan Sanbi-eye amat penting untuk memastikan orang-orang ini terkawal.” Menarik nafas dalam dan memejamkan matanya untuk mendapatkan semula ketenangannya, Neferteri meneruskan. “Walau bagaimanapun, walaupun semua tahu mereka tidak akan sebegitu teliti seperti pengembara berpangkat tinggi, mereka langsung tidak menjumpai sebarang jejak. Tiada serangan dari haiwan liar. Tiada serangan dari penyamun. Tiada mayat. Dengan itu, buktikan kepada saya bahawa anda tidak terlibat."

6567c627a1a1.en: "It has been twenty-six days since his last letter." Neferteri broke the silence. "What will other kingdoms think of the Sanbi Royals' abilities when we cannot even protect one of our contractors?"
6567c627a1a1.t: "Sudah dua puluh enam hari sejak surat terakhirnya." Neferteri memecah kesunyian. "Apa yang akan difikirkan kerajaan-kerajaan lain tentang keupayaan Keluarga Diraja Sanbi apabila kita tidak dapat pun melindungi salah seorang kontraktor kita?"

66cb1eaee84b.en: Sora walked into the room as if she were walking towards a public beheading—her own beheading.
66cb1eaee84b.t: Sora berjalan masuk ke dalam bilik seolah-olah dia berjalan menuju ke hukuman pancung awam—hukuman pancungnya sendiri.

6937f2081a55.en: The peaceful sanctity of Sanbi's economical department was once again perturbed! This tall figure with a certain aura stood in front of Eiri, like many times before. Except this time seemed unusual. This royal figure had no letter to hand off!
6937f2081a55.t: Kesucian yang aman di jabatan ekonomi Sanbi sekali lagi diganggu! Susuk tinggi dengan aura tertentu ini berdiri di hadapan Eiri, seperti banyak kali sebelumnya. Kecuali kali ini kelihatan luar biasa. Susuk diraja ini tidak membawa surat untuk diserahkan!

7148d0ef565a.en: "Neferteri now sending her lackeys to do her bidding?" The captain of the Forway embassy in Sanbi spoke resolutely and with the same intensity as its decor. His black cap had his name, Lofinghy, inscribed in a red plaque, with aquamarine balls decorating it.
7148d0ef565a.t: "Neferteri sekarang hantar orang suruhan dia buat kerja dia?" Kapten kedutaan Forway di Sanbi bercakap dengan tegas dan dengan keamatan yang sama seperti hiasannya. Topi hitamnya mempunyai namanya, Lofinghy, terukir pada plak merah, dengan bola-bola aquamarine menghiasinya.

72dda523df70.en: Chapter V - Big Momma · Vol 3 - Third Wheel · #HusbandOutWorld
72dda523df70.t: Bab V - Mama Besar · Jilid 3 - Kacau Daun · #HusbandOutWorld

75751585abb6.en: Eiri shook her head. "Thank you, Captain!"

7d90f70037af.en: "What? That's the truth!" Eiri cleaned out the jar and shoved the last remnants of the deliciously bitter but milky cake into her mouth, softly enjoying the last remnants of peace she could find.
7d90f70037af.t: "Apa? Tu kebenarannya!" Eiri mengosongkan balang itu dan menyumbat sisa-sisa terakhir kek yang pahit tetapi bersusu dan lazat itu ke dalam mulutnya, perlahan-lahan menikmati sisa-sisa terakhir ketenangan yang dapat dijumpainya.

7e0d36ed5db3.en: Lofinghy stood up and placed his hands behind his back, making his aura and chest even more pronounced. However, his tone seemed less formal, more like his authentic voice, "Tell Kibe I have an apprentice lined up for him. He's a nitpicky asshole, but he's a good kid! He will fix these lazy guards of yours." He paused for a bit, "Coema still in Newland?"
7e0d36ed5db3.t: Lofinghy berdiri dan meletakkan tangannya di belakang, menjadikan aura dan dadanya lebih ketara. Namun, nadanya kelihatan kurang formal, lebih seperti suara sebenarnya, "Bagi tahu Kibe aku dah sediakan perantis untuk dia. Dia bangsat yang cerewet, tapi dia budak baik! Dia akan betulkan pengawal-pengawal malas korang ni." Dia berhenti seketika, "Coema masih kat Newland?"

7f7c76ff8533.en: "Figure it out and get me in writing from your courtroom scientist." Lofinghy then asked straight, "Anything else?"
7f7c76ff8533.t: "Selesaikan dan beri saya secara bertulis dari saintis istana awak." Lofinghy kemudian bertanya terus, "Ada apa-apa lagi?"

809b569db028.en: "I am currently assessing options. I will inform you of what I decide." Without looking back, Neferteri walked towards the door and opened it to a familiar red-haired maid, nervously sweating and shallow breathing by the door. "My dear Sora, indeed great timing! Come on in!"
809b569db028.t: "Saya sedang menilai pilihan-pilihan. Saya akan memaklumkan anda tentang apa yang saya putuskan." Tanpa menoleh ke belakang, Neferteri berjalan ke arah pintu dan membukanya kepada seorang pembantu rumah berambut merah yang dikenali, berpeluh gementar dan bernafas cetek di tepi pintu. "Sora sayang, sungguh tepat pada masanya! Silakan masuk!"

836510c4534d.en: With a mouthful, Eiri blurted out, "Wha—?" With a gulp, she continued, "I sent him like three sanbi mail and one winga mail! He never replied—"
836510c4534d.t: Dengan mulut penuh, Eiri terhambur, "Apa—?" Dengan telanan, dia meneruskan, "Aku hantar dia macam tiga sanbi mail dan satu winga mail! Dia tak pernah balas—"

89030bbf518e.en: “Hm.” A short hum came out of the captain, moving his hand and pounding the door twice. The vibration nearly shook the place down.
89030bbf518e.t: “Hm.” Dengungan pendek keluar dari kapten, menggerakkan tangannya dan mengetuk pintu dua kali. Getarannya hampir meruntuhkan tempat itu.

8e3b1b07da8a.en: A girly cough came out of Sora, drowning in her own tea at the apparent salacious thought. The status came alive! Then, she went back to frozen when she started breathing again.
8e3b1b07da8a.t: Batuk keperempuanan keluar dari Sora, lemas dalam tehnya sendiri kerana fikiran lucah yang jelas. Patung itu hidup! Kemudian, dia kembali membeku apabila dia mula bernafas semula.

8ec4cad23dc0.en: A small, nervous, girly giggle came out of Sora, but then it became deadly serious, "Me too?"
8ec4cad23dc0.t: Kikikan kecil keperempuanan yang gementar keluar dari Sora, tetapi kemudian ia menjadi sangat serius, "Saya pun?"

916ebae6fe83.en: With a strained voice, Sora rapped back, "What if we put a search quest?"
916ebae6fe83.t: Dengan suara yang tegang, Sora merap kembali, "Macam mana kalau kita letak misi pencarian?"

92dd1db5b21d.en: "We got two level threes!" Lofinghy did not look towards the guard, giving the same hand wave as before.
92dd1db5b21d.t: "Kita dapat dua tahap tiga!" Lofinghy tidak memandang ke arah pengawal, memberi lambaian tangan yang sama seperti tadi.

9716acf97ee9.en: "Maybe she went to Forway first before going to her parents' place! I mean!" Eiri's eyes kept on searching for an answer, "She spent a few years at Forway, after all! We all have friends there! Maybe she has a boyfriend we don't know about!" Eiri stood up firmly, "I know it! Maybe Harry and Arukia fell in love and decided to flee their contracts with Sanbi! I mean, Harry is clearly not Arukia's type! He doesn't even have a single ball to his name! But love is love!" She tapped the yellow glove on her breast as her face saddened at another possible realization, "Or maybe she just needed some personal space like Harry! I'm sorry that I can be too much sometimes! I don't blame them! I did the same to my mom!" She looked at Coema's sassy-looking portrait, then made the same sassy-looking face as if suddenly possessed by her spirit when she looked back at Neferteri, "Now she's doing that to you too!"
9716acf97ee9.t: "Mungkin dia pergi Forway dulu sebelum ke rumah ibu bapa dia! Maksud aku!" Mata Eiri terus mencari jawapan, "Dia dah habiskan beberapa tahun kat Forway, lagipun! Kita semua ada kawan kat sana! Mungkin dia ada teman lelaki yang kita tak tahu!" Eiri berdiri dengan tegas, "Aku tahu! Mungkin Harry dan Arukia jatuh cinta dan memutuskan untuk lari dari kontrak mereka dengan Sanbi! Maksud aku, Harry jelas bukan citarasa Arukia! Dia tak ada sebiji bola pun atas nama dia! Tapi cinta tetap cinta!" Dia mengetuk sarung tangan kuning di dadanya sementara wajahnya menjadi sedih dengan satu lagi kemungkinan kesedaran, "Atau mungkin dia cuma perlukan ruang peribadi macam Harry! Maaf aku kadang-kadang terlalu berlebihan! Aku tak salahkan mereka! Aku buat benda yang sama kat mak aku!" Dia memandang potret Coema yang kelihatan sinis, kemudian membuat muka sinis yang sama seolah-olah tiba-tiba dirasuk rohnya ketika dia menoleh kembali ke arah Neferteri, "Sekarang dia buat benda tu kat awak juga!"

9a4e6e525b0d.en: A crack surfaced on Neferteri's stoic face. It looked like she was trying to hold a cough inside her, but you could see her muscles tense up, holding back something that wasn't a cough. Closing her eyes, she took a deep breath to reset herself. "Regardless of what is happening, we shall not take a spur-of-the-moment action, for we do not truly know if this is a mere act of coincidence, or correlated by these two acting together, or a third party acting by sequestering these two. This matter is now under my department to investigate in coordination with the courtroom scientist."
9a4e6e525b0d.t: Retakan muncul pada wajah tabah Neferteri. Ia kelihatan seperti dia cuba menahan batuk di dalam, tetapi anda dapat melihat ototnya menegang, menahan sesuatu yang bukan batuk. Memejamkan matanya, dia menarik nafas dalam untuk menetapkan semula dirinya. "Tanpa mengira apa yang berlaku, kita tidak akan mengambil tindakan terburu-buru, kerana kita tidak benar-benar tahu sama ada ini sekadar kebetulan, atau berkait dengan kedua-dua mereka bertindak bersama, atau pihak ketiga bertindak dengan menahan kedua-dua mereka. Perkara ini kini di bawah jabatan saya untuk disiasat dengan kerjasama saintis istana."

9d38deeff5f8.en: "What if one of the other maids posts the quest?" Sora held Eiri's hands as her arms squished her, not letting go of each other.
9d38deeff5f8.t: "Macam mana kalau salah seorang pembantu rumah lain yang letak misi tu?" Sora memegang tangan Eiri sementara lengannya menghimpitnya, tidak melepaskan satu sama lain.

9e39e7b1a83d.en: Lofinghy ignored looking at the live statue and instead focused straight on Eiri. "Level three or four?"
9e39e7b1a83d.t: Lofinghy mengabaikan patung hidup itu dan sebaliknya menumpukan perhatian terus kepada Eiri. "Tahap tiga atau empat?"

a006b015dd8e.en: "Yep. No plans to come back." Eiri took a sip of her tea. It was cold, but still had a good, green, herbal taste. Her hands were slightly shaking. “Haven’t heard from her in a while.”
a006b015dd8e.t: "Yep. Tak ada rancangan nak balik." Eiri meneguk tehnya. Ia sejuk, tetapi masih mempunyai rasa herba hijau yang sedap. Tangannya sedikit menggeletar. “Dah lama tak dengar khabar dia.”

a2a048315ee2.en: "Yes, Cap!" A guard swiftly opened the door.
a2a048315ee2.t: "Baik, Kap!" Seorang pengawal dengan pantas membuka pintu.

a2ebbe7fc4de.en: We’re family, and we can help build her a new home if she finds the one.
a2ebbe7fc4de.t: Kami keluarga, dan kami boleh tolong bina rumah baru untuknya jika dia jumpa jodohnya.

a6765a1cc3bd.en: "That is not all you have to say—right, my dear? Safe to presume you ran to her home and enquired with people as to when she left?" A soft, pleasing smile shone on Neferteri like a mother seeing a daughter take a step on her own into womanhood.
a6765a1cc3bd.t: "Bukan itu sahaja yang perlu kamu katakan—betul, sayang? Selamat untuk menganggap kamu berlari ke rumahnya dan bertanya kepada orang ramai bila dia pergi?" Senyuman lembut dan menyenangkan bersinar pada Neferteri seperti seorang ibu melihat anak perempuannya melangkah sendiri ke alam kewanitaan.

a75122548e82.en: Lofinghy placed his hand on one of the letters. "Arukia. Any desertion behavior?" The captain did not even blink with the amount of focus he seemed to be putting into this matter.
a75122548e82.t: Lofinghy meletakkan tangannya pada salah satu surat. "Arukia. Ada tingkah laku melarikan diri?" Kapten itu tidak berkelip pun dengan jumlah tumpuan yang kelihatan diberikannya kepada perkara ini.

a885d0243b51.en: "Yes, Cap!" The guard just as swiftly closed the door.
a885d0243b51.t: "Baik, Kap!" Pengawal itu sama pantas menutup pintu.

ab9ced472b68.en: With a raised eyebrow, Eiri replied with a brittle voice, "What? That I'm done for?"
ab9ced472b68.t: Dengan kening terangkat, Eiri menjawab dengan suara yang rapuh, "Apa? Yang aku dah tamat?"

afff26073e77.en: What would Mom do? Eiri looked back again at the sassy portrait, but it still didn't offer any insights back at her. "I—just don't know what to do! Like, I could get Half-cruro involved, but not like they can help that much searching for people! Most of them can't even tell Wozefaries and Humans apart!"
afff26073e77.t: Apa yang Mak akan buat? Eiri menoleh lagi ke arah potret yang sinis itu, tetapi ia masih tidak memberikan sebarang pandangan kepadanya. "Aku—tak tahu nak buat apa! Macam, aku boleh libatkan Half-cruro, tapi bukannya mereka boleh banyak bantu cari orang! Kebanyakan mereka pun tak boleh bezakan Wozefaries dengan Manusia!"

b08defd44c52.en: "On the contrary. You're truly Coema's daughter. For better or for worse." Neferteri glanced over at the smirky-looking portrait of a seasoned woman, "You two have a certain way with words that I can always derive the truth out of you, regardless of the situation.” Looking back at Eiri, she continued with a soft smile, “With that said, I do request that you not intervene in my operations. Unlike Coema, I can find a replacement for you in due time." With a very slight bow, Neferteri turned towards the door.
b08defd44c52.t: "Sebaliknya. Anda benar-benar anak perempuan Coema. Baik atau buruk." Neferteri mengerling potret seorang wanita berpengalaman yang kelihatan sinis, "Anda berdua mempunyai cara tertentu dengan kata-kata sehingga saya sentiasa dapat memperoleh kebenaran daripada anda, tidak kira situasinya.” Memandang kembali Eiri, dia meneruskan dengan senyuman lembut, “Dengan itu, saya meminta anda tidak campur tangan dalam operasi saya. Tidak seperti Coema, saya boleh mencari pengganti untuk anda pada masanya." Dengan tunduk yang sangat sedikit, Neferteri berpaling ke arah pintu.

b0b79239ac32.en: Glancing at the names on the envelopes, Lofinghy demanded, "Logs for Arukia Long-Bridge, maid at Sanbi Kingdom, and Harry Sanbi, working as Sanbi-eye." He waved his hand towards the guard without looking.
b0b79239ac32.t: Mengerling nama-nama pada sampul surat, Lofinghy menuntut, "Log untuk Arukia Long-Bridge, pembantu rumah di Kerajaan Sanbi, dan Harry Sanbi, bekerja sebagai Sanbi-eye." Dia melambai tangannya ke arah pengawal tanpa memandang.

b1e5beedf58e.en: Vol 3 Chapter IV subchapter 1: a man in white armor sits at a café table with the red-haired maid and the blonde girl.
b1e5beedf58e.t: Jilid 3 Bab IV subbab 1: seorang lelaki berperisai putih duduk di meja kafe dengan pembantu rumah berambut merah dan gadis berambut perang.

b23f6bc480ec.en: Sora's sweat filled the room with a distinct smell, a sweeter variety, but not pungent. Visibly shaking, she handed Neferteri the envelope with a broken seal with both hands. One would think her beheading was nearly about to happen by looking at her tearing up even more than Eiri, but alas, it was just her trembling even more seeing Neferteri retrieving the letter from inside and perusing through the contents with the same stoic expression as usual.
b23f6bc480ec.t: Peluh Sora memenuhi bilik dengan bau yang tersendiri, jenis yang lebih manis, tetapi tidak menusuk. Jelas menggeletar, dia menyerahkan kepada Neferteri sampul surat dengan meterai yang pecah dengan kedua-dua tangan. Orang akan sangka hukuman pancungnya hampir berlaku melihat dia berair mata lebih daripada Eiri, tetapi sayangnya, ia hanya dia menggeletar lebih kuat melihat Neferteri mengeluarkan surat dari dalam dan meneliti isinya dengan riak tabah yang sama seperti biasa.

b76d3596b3e2.en: "Sora?" Eiri questioned the living statue. Her mind blanked on that fact—no memories of that at all.
b76d3596b3e2.t: "Sora?" Eiri bertanya kepada patung hidup itu. Fikirannya kosong tentang fakta itu—langsung tiada ingatan tentangnya.

b7a72dd6d52b.en: Looking at this mirage of machinations in the shape of a human, Eiri slipped out a simple, "Hi?" Her mind was devoid of what to think of this, yet another encounter with her, for it didn't matter what she did or did not do; she would surely get in the way of whatever the queen of Sanbi was trying to do.
b7a72dd6d52b.t: Memandang fatamorgana muslihat dalam bentuk manusia ini, Eiri melepaskan "Hai?" yang ringkas. Fikirannya kosong tentang apa yang hendak difikirkan tentang ini, satu lagi pertemuan dengannya, kerana tidak kira apa yang dia buat atau tidak buat; dia pasti akan menghalang apa jua yang cuba dilakukan oleh permaisuri Sanbi.

bb0fd6d0598b.en: Sora's eyes bulged wide, and a slack jaw opened towards Eiri.
bb0fd6d0598b.t: Mata Sora terbeliak luas, dan rahangnya terlopong ke arah Eiri.

bd17b5b12c82.en: "Times such as these require transparency to purge the uncertainty." Neferteri extended her hand towards Sora.
bd17b5b12c82.t: "Masa-masa seperti ini memerlukan ketelusan untuk menghapuskan ketidakpastian." Neferteri menghulurkan tangannya ke arah Sora.

bfb0a0a2198a.en: "Hmm—" Something wanted to slip out of Eiri's mouth, but she was abruptly interrupted.
bfb0a0a2198a.t: "Hmm—" Sesuatu mahu terlepas dari mulut Eiri, tetapi dia tiba-tiba dipotong.

c0757d7400b3.en: Eiri looked up and down on this tall, muscular, absolute unit of utter balding manliness. Part of her brain tickled nicely with feeling up his arm, but the seriousness of it all also kept her imagination at bay. So, they keep logs? That's news! Eiri glanced towards Sora, her hands firmly holding the cup on the table as her face was tilted forward. Aside from the shaking, Sora appeared like a live statue, frozen in time. C'mon girl! Help me here! You're the one who had this crazy idea! Eiri kicked Sora gently again, but it was like kicking a bag of rice as she refused to unfreeze.
c0757d7400b3.t: Eiri memandang atas bawah lelaki tinggi, berotot, sebiji unit mutlak kejantanan yang botak sepenuhnya ini. Sebahagian otaknya menggeletek dengan menyenangkan memikirkan meraba lengannya, tetapi keseriusan semuanya juga mengekang imaginasinya. Jadi, mereka simpan log? Tu berita baru! Eiri mengerling ke arah Sora, tangannya memegang erat cawan di atas meja sementara mukanya condong ke hadapan. Selain menggeletar, Sora kelihatan seperti patung hidup, membeku dalam masa. Ayuh la! Tolong aku kat sini! Kau yang ada idea gila ni! Eiri menendang Sora perlahan lagi, tetapi ia seperti menendang guni beras kerana dia enggan bergerak.

c1350248dd05.en: "Hmmm—wait a chunk." Eiri looked at the back of the envelope; it was a letter written to Sora. The words she just read did not seem real at all. It felt like it was all a prank. "So she disappeared as well?" A sinking feeling pulled at Eiri's heart; her mind was in turmoil, trying to understand everything happening at once. Everything felt so weird that the peaceful sanctity of the economical office felt like it had been thoroughly violated, like a girl in a tentacle porn. Eiri stared back at the calendar, seeing today as Paulin's 77th, with Arukia leaving on PTO on the 68th and returning on the 82nd. Her voice grew brittler again, "But she told me she would write when she arrived! Maybe Sora's letter had arrived before she had arrived! Hmmm—Maybe she did something around town and took longer? I mean!" Her gloved hands crumpled the edges of the letter. "What if Arukia is visiting someone else first? She was always too shy to talk about herself!"
c1350248dd05.t: "Hmmm—kejap satu chunk." Eiri memandang belakang sampul surat itu; ia surat yang ditulis kepada Sora. Kata-kata yang baru dibacanya langsung tidak kelihatan nyata. Rasanya seperti semuanya gurauan. "Jadi dia pun hilang?" Perasaan tenggelam menarik hati Eiri; fikirannya bergolak, cuba memahami segala yang berlaku sekaligus. Segalanya terasa begitu pelik sehingga kesucian yang aman di pejabat ekonomi terasa seperti telah dicabul sepenuhnya, seperti seorang gadis dalam porno sesungut. Eiri merenung kembali kalendar, melihat hari ini 77 Paulin, dengan Arukia bercuti pada 68 haribulan dan kembali pada 82 haribulan. Suaranya menjadi lebih rapuh lagi, "Tapi dia cakap kat aku dia akan tulis bila dia sampai! Mungkin surat Sora sampai sebelum dia sampai! Hmmm—Mungkin dia buat sesuatu kat bandar dan ambil masa lebih lama? Maksud aku!" Tangannya yang bersarung merenyukkan tepi surat itu. "Macam mana kalau Arukia melawat orang lain dulu? Dia selalu terlalu malu nak cakap pasal diri dia!"

c32d57510675.en: With a slight smile on the corner of her mouth, Neferteri continued speaking softly with her eyes closed, "My dearest King-maid." She opened her eyes and stared deeply into Eiri's soul with a piercing intensity almost no one could muster. "Harry's last letter, in the fifty-second, stated that he was approached in Green Sea by a stranger who asked him three questions. How was he feeling? Did he need any help? And last, did he hate the King-maid?"
c32d57510675.t: Dengan senyuman kecil di sudut mulutnya, Neferteri terus bercakap perlahan dengan mata tertutup, "King-maid yang dikasihi." Dia membuka matanya dan merenung jauh ke dalam jiwa Eiri dengan keamatan menusuk yang hampir tiada sesiapa dapat kerahkan. "Surat terakhir Harry, pada lima puluh dua haribulan, menyatakan bahawa dia didekati di Green Sea oleh seorang asing yang bertanya tiga soalan kepadanya. Bagaimana perasaannya? Adakah dia memerlukan sebarang bantuan? Dan akhir sekali, adakah dia membenci King-maid?"

c3af6907c500.en: "Spare me your delusions." Neferteri focused her dagger stare on Sora, making her recoil into her own shell, even more afraid that she sounded like she had stopped breathing, "Sora, I appreciate your proactive investigative skills. On this front, you're far better suited to the King-Maid role."
c3af6907c500.t: "Jauhkan saya daripada khayalan anda." Neferteri menumpukan renungan tajamnya pada Sora, membuatkannya mengecut ke dalam cengkerangnya sendiri, lebih takut sehingga dia kedengaran seperti telah berhenti bernafas, "Sora, saya menghargai kemahiran penyiasatan proaktif kamu. Dalam hal ini, kamu jauh lebih sesuai untuk peranan King-Maid."

c3c1ac94648f.en: With a slow, silent nod, Neferteri folded the letter and handed it to Eiri. "This does not seem to be a product of mere happenstance."
c3c1ac94648f.t: Dengan anggukan perlahan dan senyap, Neferteri melipat surat itu dan menyerahkannya kepada Eiri. "Ini tidak kelihatan sebagai hasil kebetulan semata-mata."

c555c9198f4a.en: "T—thank you, my queen!" The words slipped out quickly from Sora; her feet appeared to be in a struggle between being frozen solid to the ground and wanting to take off running at full speed.
c555c9198f4a.t: "T—terima kasih, Permaisuriku!" Kata-kata itu terlepas dengan cepat dari Sora; kakinya kelihatan bergelut antara membeku kaku di tanah dan mahu berlari sepantas mungkin.

c6bfc4e1ec1c.en: "Yes! Fuck it!" Eiri took a determined breath, "I will even use the department budget for the search quests! Fuck it! If she fires us, I will come out in public and say she refused to help search for them. Let's go to the embassy tomorrow and talk to Lofinghy!"
c6bfc4e1ec1c.t: "Ya! Peduli apa!" Eiri menarik nafas yang penuh tekad, "Aku siap akan guna bajet jabatan untuk misi pencarian! Peduli apa! Kalau dia pecat kita, aku akan keluar ke khalayak ramai dan cakap dia enggan tolong cari mereka. Jom pergi kedutaan esok dan bercakap dengan Lofinghy!"

cc5b9a4e6b14.en: Eiri flapped open the handwritten letter; it was a bit hard to read as the lines were not smooth, but it was still doable if you focused on it.
cc5b9a4e6b14.t: Eiri membuka surat bertulisan tangan itu; ia agak sukar dibaca kerana garisan-garisannya tidak licin, tetapi masih boleh jika anda menumpukan perhatian.

ce2a5bf20808.en: Sora's trembling hands gave way to a body growing soft like she was about to pass out—again. At least that was the case until Eiri gave a slight kick into her hanging feet under the table, making her body shake up like she had just done a cold plunge. Her eyes remained tightly closed as her soul attempted to fight its way out of her mortal body—a sort of demonic possession or trance happening. Or perhaps a side effect of nari gel dependence. She kept holding the cup of tea in her mouth, stuck sipping it indefinitely.
ce2a5bf20808.t: Tangan Sora yang menggeletar memberi laluan kepada badan yang menjadi lembik seperti dia hendak pengsan—lagi. Sekurang-kurangnya begitulah sehingga Eiri memberi tendangan kecil pada kakinya yang tergantung di bawah meja, membuatkan badannya tersentak seperti dia baru terjun ke dalam air sejuk. Matanya kekal tertutup rapat sementara jiwanya cuba melawan keluar dari badan fananya—sejenis kerasukan syaitan atau berkhayal sedang berlaku. Atau mungkin kesan sampingan kebergantungan nari gel. Dia terus memegang cawan teh di mulutnya, tersangkut menghirupnya tanpa henti.

d233c9692a2f.en: Sora replied softly, "I can take PTO and search for Arukia, then Harry!"
d233c9692a2f.t: Sora menjawab dengan perlahan, "Saya boleh ambil cuti dan cari Arukia, lepas tu Harry!"

d4b8ca98894e.en: Neferteri closed her eyes and slowly shook her head, waiting until Eiri stopped her vapid blabbering.
d4b8ca98894e.t: Neferteri memejamkan matanya dan perlahan-lahan menggeleng kepala, menunggu sehingga Eiri berhenti merepek kosong.

dc9065e5acc1.en: Eiri's racing thoughts seemed to calm down somewhat as she kept inhaling the sweetish, sweaty smell from Sora—her tender warmth as she sat between her legs also helped. "This whole month has been weird, and I don't know what to do!"
dc9065e5acc1.t: Fikiran Eiri yang berlumba-lumba seakan-akan tenang sedikit sementara dia terus menghidu bau peluh yang agak manis dari Sora—kehangatannya yang lembut ketika dia duduk di antara kaki Eiri juga membantu. "Sebulan ni memang pelik, dan aku tak tahu nak buat apa!"

dcf5b28cc928.en: "What?" Eiri gave up on the letter and rested it on the table.
dcf5b28cc928.t: "Apa?" Eiri berputus asa dengan surat itu dan meletakkannya di atas meja.

e0a817551d65.en: "Just like my mom! There's a reason why I am here! Because I know this shit better than anybody out there!" With a deflating breath, Eiri sat back down, her voice growing weaker, "Why can't I get some deserved respect?" Despite the turmoil of emotions, a weirdly good vibe took over. It was like slicing open an infected wound and forcing out the pus. It was still hurting, but that pressure was no longer there. *Argh! Sanbi shit—*a tinge of remorse now struck Eiri right at the pit of her stomach.
e0a817551d65.t: "Sama macam mak aku! Ada sebab kenapa aku kat sini! Sebab aku tahu benda sial ni lebih baik daripada sesiapa kat luar sana!" Dengan nafas yang mengempis, Eiri duduk kembali, suaranya semakin lemah, "Kenapa aku tak boleh dapat sedikit penghormatan yang sepatutnya?" Walaupun pergolakan emosi, aura baik yang pelik mengambil alih. Ia seperti menghiris luka yang dijangkiti dan memaksa nanah keluar. Ia masih sakit, tetapi tekanan itu tidak lagi ada. *Argh! Demi jiwa tua Sanbi—*sedikit rasa menyesal kini menyerang Eiri tepat di ulu hatinya.

e6562f74108f.en: "Someone Arukia was often communicating with, and the last message she picked up from this embassy on Paulin 66th." Picking up a small black note from within the tome, he brought it up to his eyes, "Emelia is the owner of Emelia's Flowery Paradise in Southwest Forway."
e6562f74108f.t: "Seseorang yang Arukia selalu berhubung, dan mesej terakhir yang dia ambil dari kedutaan ini pada 66 Paulin." Mengambil nota hitam kecil dari dalam buku tebal itu, dia mendekatkannya ke matanya, "Emelia ialah pemilik Emelia's Flowery Paradise di Barat Daya Forway."

e7bdba40d570.en: "I shall ask this only once." Neferteri came one step closer, looking down on Eiri even more than before, "Why do you keep insisting on trying to communicate with him?"
e7bdba40d570.t: "Saya akan bertanya ini sekali sahaja." Neferteri melangkah setapak lebih dekat, memandang rendah Eiri lebih daripada sebelumnya, "Mengapa anda terus berkeras cuba berhubung dengannya?"

eadff0d4030e.en: Eiri put her ear closer to it and heard a string of words so clearly it felt like her heart stopped beating for a second. Her body froze briefly as the words rattled in her brain, Maybe it was Neferteri all along? These words spoken by a sweet, fast-paced girl felt way more profound than it was supposed to be. She whispered back in her ears, "How? How would we know?"
eadff0d4030e.t: Eiri mendekatkan telinganya dan mendengar rentetan kata-kata begitu jelas sehingga terasa seperti jantungnya berhenti berdegup seketika. Badannya membeku sebentar sementara kata-kata itu bergegar dalam otaknya, Mungkin Neferteri dari awal? Kata-kata yang diucapkan oleh seorang gadis manis yang laju ini terasa jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang sepatutnya. Dia berbisik kembali di telinganya, "Macam mana? Macam mana kita nak tahu?"

edb1fb8b2079.en: A quick, silent denial came out of Sora with a quick headshake, still not daring to open her eyes.
edb1fb8b2079.t: Penafian senyap yang cepat keluar dari Sora dengan gelengan kepala yang cepat, masih tidak berani membuka matanya.

eeda7296e009.en: Vol 3 Chapter III subchapter 6: the blonde girl and the red-haired maid study a large chart of colored dots on the wall.
eeda7296e009.t: Jilid 3 Bab III subbab 6: gadis berambut perang dan pembantu rumah berambut merah meneliti carta besar titik-titik berwarna di dinding.

ef223c0eecc3.en: "We can't! Neferteri said so!" Eiri continued hugging Sora. "What if we—" An ideation seemed to want to form in her brain, but like having something stuck on the tip of the tongue, it just got stuck in the cogs and never fully formed. "I don't know! Something! We gotta do something!"
ef223c0eecc3.t: "Tak boleh! Neferteri dah cakap!" Eiri terus memeluk Sora. "Macam mana kalau kita—" Satu idea seakan-akan mahu terbentuk dalam otaknya, tetapi seperti sesuatu tersangkut di hujung lidah, ia hanya tersangkut dalam gear dan tidak pernah terbentuk sepenuhnya. "Aku tak tahu! Sesuatu! Kita kena buat sesuatu!"

f0673d34e043.en: Sora reacted as well, but it was indescribable if she was laughing, sobbing, celebrating, terrified, or having a moment of reprieve—maybe all of that at the same time.
f0673d34e043.t: Sora bertindak balas juga, tetapi tidak dapat digambarkan sama ada dia ketawa, teresak-esak, meraikan, ketakutan, atau mengalami saat kelegaan—mungkin semuanya pada masa yang sama.

f10c07eab836.en: The captain touched the other letter, "And no romantic or other kind of relation between these two?"
f10c07eab836.t: Kapten itu menyentuh surat yang lain, "Dan tiada hubungan romantik atau hubungan lain antara mereka berdua?"

f1a9aaa2c840.en: "Level three kingdom alert is one aquamarine to post plus reward. Level four emergency is one sapphire to post plus reward." Lofinghy stated plainly.
f1a9aaa2c840.t: "Amaran kerajaan tahap tiga ialah satu aquamarine untuk disiarkan ditambah ganjaran. Kecemasan tahap empat ialah satu sapphire untuk disiarkan ditambah ganjaran." Lofinghy menyatakan dengan terus terang.

f5ef311bb612.en: "Hmmmm—no?" Eiri, feeling the afrontal headwind from this behemoth of a manly man, avoided his gaze and looked toward the letters before him. "The only thing different is that she never took PTO before. I mean, she did, but only when I insisted. This is the first time she actually asked for it! But I guess it makes total sense after seeing Gabiro's soul die. Even I thought about finding a way to visit my mom in Newland."
f5ef311bb612.t: "Hmmmm—tak?" Eiri, merasa angin kencang dari depan dari lelaki jantan raksasa ini, mengelak renungannya dan memandang ke arah surat-surat di hadapannya. "Satu-satunya benda yang lain ialah dia tak pernah ambil cuti sebelum ni. Maksud saya, dia pernah, tapi cuma bila saya desak. Ni kali pertama dia betul-betul minta! Tapi rasanya memang masuk akal lepas tengok jiwa Gabiro mati. Saya pun terfikir nak cari cara melawat mak saya kat Newland."

f788c3024deb.en: Eiri rushed to her, hugging and sobbing as well. So much to say, yet nothing came out at that moment. Only tears.
f788c3024deb.t: Eiri bergegas kepadanya, memeluk dan teresak-esak juga. Begitu banyak untuk dikatakan, namun tiada apa yang keluar pada saat itu. Hanya air mata.

fc73158f09a6.en: Neferteri stepped back, inhaling deeply. Her thumb and forefinger pressed against the bridge of her nose, grounding herself for a moment of silence.
fc73158f09a6.t: Neferteri berundur, menarik nafas dalam. Ibu jari dan jari telunjuknya menekan batang hidungnya, membumikan dirinya untuk seketika kesunyian.

fd6f63fc5853.en: Sora's body limply plunged forward as her soul freed itself from this mortal plane. Her empty tea cup bounced forward, bounded on the table, then shattered into a million pieces against the ground.
fd6f63fc5853.t: Badan Sora tersungkur lembik ke hadapan sementara jiwanya membebaskan diri dari alam fana ini. Cawan tehnya yang kosong melantun ke hadapan, terlonjak di atas meja, kemudian berkecai menjadi sejuta kepingan di lantai.
